paite: Joseph suante tantuam, Jeriko zawn a pan gamdai kiang, suahlam pang Jeriko tuite ah asuak a, Jeriko a pan singtang gam ah Bethel pha in apaitou zel hi.
heading: Ephraim Leh Tumlam Manasseh Gam Tan

paite: Bethel a pan Luz ah alut a, Arki mite gamgi a Ataroth pha in apai zel hi.
Tumlam pang ah Japhlet suante gamgi, Beth-horon gamgi khangnungzaw, Gezer pha in apaisuk zel a; tupi ah asuak hi.
Huchi in Joseph suante Manasseh leh Ephraim suante'n tantuam in alata uhi.
A-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Ephraim suante gamgi hiai ahi: Suahlam pang atantuam uh gamgi Ataroth-addar ahi a, Beth-horon saknungzaw apha hi.
heading: Ephraim

paite: Mikmethath maltum lam pang ah asuak a, suahlam pang ah Taanath-shiloh pha in akihei nawn a, Janohah suahlam ah apai zel hi.
Janohah a pan Ataroth ah, Naarah ah apaisuk a, Jeriko atung a, Jordan ah asuak hi.
Tappuah a pan tumlam pang ah Kanah luita pha in apai a; tuipi ah asuak hi. Huaite ahi Ephraim suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam uh.
Manasseh suante tantuam lak a Ephraim suante a dia khopi asehtuamsakte toh; akhopi tengteng leh akhotate leng.
Gezer a teng Kanaante adelhkhe kei ua; Ephraimte lak ah Kanaante tuni tan in a-om lai ua, asikha un a-om uhi.
